CropWeave is in beta. Your feedback helps us tune future puzzles.

How to play

Choose a tile, then an empty square. Arrange every tile and finish your farm to lock in the score. You can rearrange and undo before finishing.

Neighbors share a side. Some tiles also score diagonally or along a line. Inspect a placed tile to see every bonus. A Well, Pond, or river irrigates a crop once, and pollination and protection also count once per crop.

Use arrow keys to move around the plot and Enter to place or inspect. When Hold to preview is enabled, press P on a legal square for a preview.
